title: Luis Enrique extends contract as PSG coach until 2030
summary: The Paris Saint-Germain coach, joined by those five Champions League winners, was given a raucous reception from home fans at Parc des Princes stadium on Friday when the announcement was made ahead of the game against Monaco. PSG went on to lose 2-1, leaving the team still without a win three matches into the new Ligue 1 season.
